sermon.title: A Real Champion is a Genuine Server
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows that Jesus, the champion of champions, came to serve and was ministered to without demanding. The women who followed him to the cross and tomb were first to see him risen. Worship, thanks and repentance are weapons; rulers in God’s kingdom serve, as Rehoboam’s elders advised; and simply obeying God’s word contends with the wicked.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: at 3:45 he says “Jesus was served he didn’t come to serve” (an evident slip; kept as spoken); Luke 8:2 said to name three women while two are named; Proverbs 28:4 spoken as “20 84”; foot washing as a requirement for widows; Solomon not commanded to build his palace; Jesus returning in a body “with no blood in it”; Trinity compared to being father, son and husband. Sensitive content kept as spoken: signing up for government benefits as a test; government of America wants to control you; women who say no man will tell them what to do.

faqs.question: Is “act like men” only for men?
faqs.answer: No, Paul was speaking to the whole church.

faqs.question: Is foot washing a church ritual?
faqs.answer: He says it was an illustration of serving, not a ritual in Acts.

faqs.question: How were Jesus and his disciples fed?
faqs.answer: Women he healed ministered to him of their substance.

faqs.question: Who first met the risen Jesus?
faqs.answer: The women who had followed and ministered to him.

faqs.question: How many lepers returned to thank Jesus?
faqs.answer: One out of ten, a Samaritan.

faqs.question: What does the Father do for those who serve Jesus?
Did grace end the moral laws?
faqs.answer: He says the civil laws didn’t change; the shadow laws were fulfilled.

faqs.question: Will the Spirit tell you something contrary to the word?
